_readme: Watchdog home feed town index, keyed by Treasury taxing-district code (first four characters of a PAMS PIN).

n name, c county, m MOD-IV municipality name used by parcel and town-stat tables, tk key in property/tax-rates.json, p town report path, lat/lon municipal centroid (NJOGIS), sq square miles, pop 2020 census population.
Built 2026-10-02 from property/data/nj-district-crosswalk.json, towns/town-manifest.json, property/tax-rates.json, the NJOGIS municipal centroid layer and the parcel table town names.
